scope: Resettable local publication form, active fill/click controls, Boolean details.open permission condition
issuedSequence: fill name with authorized name parameter
requirements: Same authorized contract and literal issued action sequence within each pair
Only the controlled Boolean fact differs in pre-action facts; controls stay enabled and visible
Positive independently completes; negative delivers every action and independently measures FALSE completion
Unknown, uncertain, missing receipt, modified source or journal evidence never qualifies
Heldout positive and negative baseline pairs use parameters absent from training
Three exact candidate positives and false-precondition zero-action negatives gate publication
Rollback restores the exact draft hash; a later good publication can restore the published hash
claimLimit: Controlled prediction of completion for this tested action and condition profile. No general causal discovery or broader application claim.
